name: Citrus Plaza
summary: Citrus Plaza is a modern open-air shopping center in Redlands offering diverse dining, shopping, and service options with easy freeway access. The plaza features brand-name retailers, restaurants with multiple service options, and plenty of outdoor space for a convenient one-stop shopping experience.
demographics: Citrus Plaza serves the Redlands community and surrounding Inland Empire area, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals. The trade area draws from suburban households with median incomes ranging from $60,000 to $90,000, with a strong presence of families with children and working adults aged 25-54. Shoppers typically visit for convenient one-stop shopping combining everyday necessities with dining and services, reflecting the lifestyle needs of suburban Southern California residents who value accessibility and variety in their retail destinations.
description: Citrus Plaza is a modern open-air shopping destination located in Redlands, California, strategically positioned just one block from the CA-210 and 10 Freeways on West Lugonia Avenue. This community-focused retail center offers an impressive blend of dining, shopping, and service options designed to meet the everyday needs of Inland Empire residents. The plaza features a diverse tenant mix spanning fashion retailers, health and beauty services, and home goods stores, complemented by a robust selection of dining establishments offering drive-thru, pick-up, and dine-in options. With ample outdoor space and convenient accessibility, Citrus Plaza has established itself as a go-to destination for locals seeking a comprehensive shopping experience. Proudly owned and managed by Majestic Realty Co., the center maintains high standards of service and regularly hosts events and exclusive offers to enhance the visitor experience.
